name: Surprise Shot (Combat)
body:
You can get off a shot that attacks from an unexpected direction or one that manages to surprise a ready foe.

Prerequisite: Dex 13, Point-Blank Shot, Precise Shot, Rapid Shot

Benefit: Once per encounter you may make an attack roll against an opponent’s flat-footed AC rather than his normal AC.

Normal: You consider your opponent flat-footed for the purposes of Sneak Attack.
